title: A Moment-Based Eulerian Method for Variance-Based Finite-Time Lyapunov Exponent Computation in Stochastic Flows
summary: Variance-based finite-time Lyapunov exponents (vFTLEs) provide a stochastic analogue of deterministic FTLE by measuring the covariance of stochastic arrival locations. Existing PDF-based formulations compute this covariance by solving a Fokker--Planck equation for each initial point, which becomes expensive when the diagnostic is required on a dense grid. In this work, we develop a moment-based Eulerian approximation to vFTLE in the small-noise regime.
